data.name: Description
data.value: What Jarvis keeps about you from one conversation to the next: short facts and a summary of the old exchanges. Everything stays on this computer, and you can erase it here.

data.name: EnabledHint
data.value: Off: nothing is kept and nothing is recalled to the model. What is already kept stays visible below.

data.name: AutomaticHint
data.value: After each exchange, the local model reads what you said, and only that, and keeps up to three lasting facts. Off: Jarvis keeps a fact only when you ask ("remember that…").

data.name: FactsHint
data.value: The model receives the pinned facts first, then the most recent, up to about {0} characters with the summary. The others are found when Jarvis searches its memory.

data.name: AddPlaceholder
data.value: For example: The user prefers short answers.

data.name: Add_TooLong
data.value: A fact has 200 characters at most.

data.name: Add_LooksLikeSecret
data.value: This looks like a password, a key or a card number. Jarvis never keeps one in its memory.

data.name: Add_Full
data.value: The memory is full. Erase some facts first.

data.name: Add_Unavailable
data.value: The fact could not be saved.

data.name: SummaryHint
data.value: Written by the local model from your requests and the answers of Jarvis, without the results of the tools. It replaces the exchanges that are no longer sent word for word.

data.name: SilenceLabel
data.value: Silence after which an exchange is old (minutes)

data.name: SilenceHint
data.value: After this long without a request, the exchanges before it are no longer sent word for word: only the summary recalls them. From {0} to {1} minutes; 120 by default.

data.name: EraseHint
data.value: Erases every fact and the summary. The conversation itself is erased from its own window.

data.name: EraseConfirm
data.value: Erase every fact and the summary? This cannot be undone.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The settings file cannot be written.
